item.description:
• New "Mixed" dictation language. Pick it in Settings > Transcription when you speak more than one language in the same dictation - each language stays in its own script (Cyrillic Russian and Latin English side by side, instead of the embedded language being forced into the other's script). Listed right after English at the top of the language picker.
  • Spoken email addresses now format automatically. Turn on Settings > Snippets > "Spoken email addresses" and dictating "admin at mycompany dot com" inserts "admin@mycompany.com" - the spoken "at" becomes @, "dot" becomes ., and the address is joined and lowercased. It only triggers on a recognized domain ending (com, org, net, io, and similar), so ordinary phrases like "we met at the park" are left alone. Off by default; works with Refine on or off.
